2026_05_SF_SEA.headline: Seattle’s shifting coverage confronts Purdy as a diminished San Francisco rush meets Darnold
2026_05_SF_SEA.paragraph1: Brock Purdy faces a Seattle defense that can disguise its coverage and force longer throws, but San Francisco can counter with motion and short routes that keep the ball moving. Kyle Shanahan will be without fullback Kyle Juszczyk, removing a familiar backfield option against the Seahawks. Nick Bosa’s absence also reduces the visitors’ edge rush, giving Sam Darnold more time if Seattle protects him. The San Francisco defense must rotate coverage to challenge Darnold without leaving an easy opening for an explosive completion.
2026_05_SF_SEA.model_rationale: Seattle's coverage rotations challenge Purdy's timing, while San Francisco can adjust with short routes and movement. Without Bosa, its pass rush must find alternative ways to unsettle Darnold.
